issue: Configured model provenance hash did not match the active calibrated APSIMX artifact.

differences: Weather.FileName was rewritten from a relative path to an absolute WSL path.
Unused legacy StartDate, EndDate, MinESW, MinRain and RainDays entries were removed from each custom rotation manager.
JSON exponent formatting changed from lowercase e to uppercase E.
comparison_result.note: The custom rotation manager uses RotationSowingDates and does not declare or read the removed legacy entries.

resolution.action: Preserved the mismatching artifact and restored the byte-identical verified artifact referenced by provenance.
